component.name: Open Trofeo LCD
component.summary: Linux driver and theme editor for Thermalright Trofeo LCD

description.p: Open Trofeo LCD is a reverse-engineered Linux driver and desktop editor for the Thermalright Trofeo LCD cooler display.
This is a development preview. The backend, USB transfer path, Theme Gallery, Theme Designer, Animation Studio and packaging flow are still being refined.
Initial public development preview with source launch flow and experimental Flatpak packaging.
